title: [review] coap_dtn.c zcbor API misuse: 3-arg tstr_decode + nonexistent map_end_force_decode = compile break
description: P0. parse_recipient at lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_dtn.c:40 calls zcbor_tstr_decode(zsd, &key, 1) — zcbor API is 2-arg (zcbor_decode.h:74: bool zcbor_tstr_decode(zcbor_state_t*, struct zcbor_string*)). Line 49 calls zcbor_map_end_force_decode(zsd) — nonexistent; real symbol is zcbor_list_map_end_force_decode (zcbor_decode.h:257). Any build with CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_DEADDROP=y fails to compile. Introduced in the 6mij.2.3/.2.4 handler migration; missed because verification was cppcheck-only (not a type-checker). Fix: 2-arg calls; then west build -b qemu_x86 an app with CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_DEADDROP=y (or extend lichen/tests/coap_keys-style ztest) to prove compilation.
